nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply; assigned in the CorporateNews constructor.
Public mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding ERC20 allowances; modified by approve and transferFrom.
Public string token name, set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 number of decimals, set once in the constructor.
Public string token symbol, set once in the constructor.
Private constant 2**256 - 1 used as the unlimited-allowance sentinel in transferFrom.
Constructor: mints the whole initial amount to msg.sender and initialises totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
Public transfer: checks the sender balance, subtracts from msg.sender and adds to _to.
Public transferFrom: checks balance and allowance, moves tokens and decrements the allowance unless it is MAX_UINT256.
Public view returning the balance of _owner from the balances mapping.
Public approve: writes _value into allowed[msg.sender][_spender] without requiring the allowance to be zero first.
Public view returning the remaining allowance of _spender for _owner.
Caller-controlled address used as the balance owner in transfer, as the spender key in approve/transferFrom, and as the recipient of the initial supply.
Underflow-prone unchecked subtraction of _value from the caller balance in transfer (Solidity 0.4.x has no built-in overflow checks).
Unchecked addition of _value to the recipient balance in transfer, potential overflow of the balances mapping entry.
Unchecked addition of _value to the destination balance inside transferFrom, potential overflow.
Unchecked subtraction of _value from the source balance inside transferFrom, potential underflow.
Unchecked decrement of the caller allowance inside transferFrom; guarded only by the MAX_UINT256 sentinel check.
Constructor parameter giving the total initial token supply minted to msg.sender.
Constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter assigned to the decimals state variable.
Constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
Recipient address of the transfer function, used as the balances mapping key for the credit.
Amount of tokens moved by transfer, used in both the debit and the credit.
Source address of transferFrom, used as the balances key for the debit.
Destination address of transferFrom, used as the balances key for the credit.
Amount of tokens moved by transferFrom, applied to balances and to the allowance decrement.
Address granted the allowance in approve.
Allowance amount written by approve.
Address whose balance is queried by balanceOf.
Token owner queried by the allowance view function.
Spender queried by the allowance view function.
Local cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom, compared against _value and MAX_UINT256.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key that receives the whole initial supply inside the constructor.
The transfer function debits and credits balances using the caller address as the implicit source of funds.
approve writes the allowance under allowed[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller address flows directly into the allowed mapping.
The caller-controlled msg.sender indexes balances on the left side of an unchecked subtraction, coupling untrusted input to an arithmetic operation.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in the unchecked allowance decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
The constructor parameter _initialAmount is assigned to the totalSupply state variable.
The constructor parameter _initialAmount is credited to balances[msg.sender].
The transfer recipient _to indexes the balances mapping on the left side of an unchecked addition.
The transfer amount _value is the operand subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without overflow protection.
The transfer amount _value is the operand added to balances[_to] without overflow protection.
_from selects the source balance that constrains and is debited by the transferFrom amount.
_from indexes the balances key that is decremented by an unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
_to indexes the balances mapping on the left side of the unchecked addition in transferFrom.
_value is the operand subtracted from balances[_from] inside transferFrom without overflow protection.
The locally cached allowance value determines whether the MAX_UINT256 branch is skipped and the unchecked allowance decrement executes.
The _spender parameter of approve is stored as the key in the allowed mapping.
The _value parameter of approve is the allowance amount written to storage.
Execution of the constructor writes totalSupply.
Execution of the constructor writes the balances mapping for the deployer.
transfer sequentially executes the debit of balances[msg.sender].
transfer sequentially executes the credit of balances[_to].
transferFrom executes the credit of balances[_to] after the require checks.
transferFrom executes the debit of balances[_from] after the credit.
transferFrom conditionally executes the allowance decrement when allowance is below MAX_UINT256.

normalization_plan.reason: _initialAmount is a constructor parameter whose only role is to initialise totalSupply and the deployer balance in the CorporateNews constructor.
_tokenName is a constructor parameter stored directly into the name state variable.
_decimalUnits is a constructor parameter stored directly into the decimals state variable.
_tokenSymbol is a constructor parameter stored directly into the symbol state variable.
_to of transfer exists only as the mapping key for the balances[_to] += _value operation.
_value of transfer is the operand of the unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= _value arithmetic operation.
_from of transferFrom is only used as the key of the unchecked balances[_from] -= _value operation.
_to of transferFrom is only used as the key of the unchecked balances[_to] += _value operation.
_value of transferFrom is the operand of the unchecked balances[_from] -= _value operation.
_spender of approve is written directly into the allowed mapping by the approve function.
_value of approve is the allowance amount written by the approve function.
_owner of balanceOf is only used to read balances inside the balanceOf view function.
_owner of allowance is only used to index the allowed mapping inside the allowance view function.
_spender of allowance is only used to index the allowed mapping inside the allowance view function.
The local allowance variable gates the unchecked allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value operation in transferFrom.
